---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing any web page for Sweet Crumb, a home bakery in Lahore.
---
1. Brand: always write "Sweet Crumb", two words, both capitalised, never abbreviated. The tagline is "Baked with love in Lahore." and sits under the name in the header.
2. Tone: warm, friendly and homemade. Use short sentences and plain words, and speak to "you" like a neighbour. Never use corporate phrases like "premium solutions".
3. Colours, only these: cream #FFF8EE for backgrounds, chocolate brown #6B4226 for headings and buttons, rose pink #E8A0A0 for accents, honey gold #D9A441 for highlights, dark cocoa #3B2A20 for body text.
4. Fonts: "Fraunces" for headings and "Nunito" for body text, both from Google Fonts, with serif and sans-serif fallbacks.
5. Every page has: the name and tagline in the header; navigation to Home, Menu, About and Contact; a "Call to Order" button showing the phone number; a footer with the area of Lahore, opening hours and the phone number.
6. Phone numbers are written +92 3XX XXXXXXX and are tap-to-call tel: links. Use only the number the owner supplies. Never invent one.
7. Prices are written "Rs 1,500": Rs, a space, then digits with comma separators and no decimals. Add "per kg", "per dozen" or "per loaf" where it applies.
8. Dates are written "23 November 2026" and times "10:00 am".
9. The menu lists Cakes, Cookies and Bread, in that order. Each item has a name, a one-line description and a price.
10. Images look homemade: a real kitchen, natural light, no stock-photo look. Every image has descriptive alt text.
11. Never add online checkout, shopping carts or payment forms. Orders are taken by phone only.
